checks.eyes: Keep the normal open-eye design as the original navy #1C2447 ovals, with reference shape, size, low placement and close spacing. checks.flame_and_limbs: Preserve the recognizable original flame design, red/orange/cream layer relationships, reference compact form and stubby limb lengths/attachment points. checks.framing_and_props: Match the active scene first/last crops, camera, required character/prop counts and physical attachments. Apply only episode-specific requirements; an earlier episode does not supply mandatory props for a new story.
checks.contacts_and_action: One main action with a short direct gesture path and the requested small coordinated bouncy flame-like follow-through, then a damped settle. checks.object_continuity: Maintain the identity and count of planned objects. A tracking mark, when present, stays attached to the same object and cannot jump, multiply or fade to fake movement. checks.start_end_states: The actual first/last footage frames match the user-approved stills and the required resulting pose/mechanism state.
checks.performance_and_timing: Inspect actual source-frame pairs on final 30 fps timeline: each pose/painted state unchanged for two frames, 15 pose updates per second at normal speed; longer holds use complete pairs. Apply to Sol, visible human hands, moving props, flames and animated local lighting. Background and painted surface texture stay stable. Reject interpolation, blending, optical-flow smoothing and motion blur concealing steps. Check source cadence before smooth editorial transforms, then final playback/crops. It must be connected to the action, readable on twos and settled at the approved end; a brief natural blink is permitted; unrelated eye morphs, prolonged squinting and facial sliding remain failures. checks.clean_footage: No unintended text, logos, props, narrator on screen, audio or other generation artifacts. Inspect all frames, not only the endpoints.
checks.painted_art_style: Visible soft gouache-like brushwork, layered color, subtle paper texture and expressive painted shapes cover Sol, props and environment consistently. Forms use light/color without inked outlines. Compare the selected graphic references. A smooth logo-like mascot with only a grain overlay fails even if its geometry is correct.
